headline: Enhance CodeClip with AI-Powered Features
summary: Integrate natural language processing and machine learning to allow users to search, categorize, and organize code snippets more efficiently. Implement a recommendation system based on user behavior to suggest relevant snippets.
actions: Implement keyword extraction from code snippets using NLP techniques for better search functionality.
Develop an AI-driven categorization tool that automatically sorts snippets into predefined or custom categories.
Create a personalized snippet suggestion feature based on users' recent activities and interests.
